title: Bitcoin Near $78K, SEC Crypto Shake-Up & Schwab Expands Crypto | W3BC LIVE
description: Friday W3BC LIVE: Bitcoin steadies near $78K as markets await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole, the SEC advances a crypto-custody overhaul and proposed Regulation Crypto Assets framework, Charles Schwab plans to add SOL, AVAX and LINK, tokenized equities push RWA market cap above $30B, plus AI agents with wallets, NFL roster cuts, MLB, UFC and the Betting Desk.
openNotes: Bitcoin is near $78K in the digest; use the live Markets screen for the actual on-air price.
Today's macro catalyst is Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech and the question of what conditions would change rates.
Institutional adoption has two strong fresh angles: the SEC custody overhaul and Charles Schwab expanding Schwab Crypto to SOL, AVAX and LINK.
Tokenized equities are leading RWA inflows, with active RWA market cap reported above $30B.

newsStories.headline: Bitcoin steadies near $78K ahead of Jackson Hole
points: The digest says Bitcoin is trading near $78K after losing $80K despite eight consecutive U.S. spot ETF inflow sessions totaling about $2.8B.
Markets are focused on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech Friday for clues on rate policy.
Use live market data for the current BTC print.
newsStories.takeaway: ETF demand remains strong, but macro policy is still controlling the near-term risk backdrop.
newsStories.source: Yahoo Finance / CoinDesk / CNBC / Aug 28 digest

newsStories.headline: SEC crypto custody overhaul advances
points: The digest says the SEC is preparing changes to crypto custody rules for investment advisers.
The regulatory shift is framed around modern institutional adoption and greater flexibility.
This matters because custody rules are a gatekeeper for larger pools of traditional capital.
newsStories.takeaway: Better-defined custody rules could remove another institutional friction point.
newsStories.source: Bitcoin Foundation / Yahoo Finance / Aug 28 digest

newsStories.headline: Charles Schwab plans to expand Schwab Crypto
points: Schwab says it plans to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to the digital assets available in Schwab Crypto accounts.
The expansion puts additional major crypto assets directly in front of traditional brokerage clients.
newsStories.takeaway: Crypto access keeps moving deeper into mainstream brokerage infrastructure.

newsStories.headline: SEC proposes standalone Regulation Crypto Assets framework
points: The digest cites the SEC's Aug. 18 proposal for Regulation Crypto Assets, described as its first standalone crypto offering framework.
The proposal would create new exemptions from Securities Act registration plus tailored disclosure and reporting requirements.
newsStories.takeaway: The U.S. is moving from enforcement-era ambiguity toward purpose-built issuance rules.
newsStories.source: Mintz / Pillsbury / Gibson Dunn / Aug 28 digest

newsStories.headline: Tokenized equities lead RWA inflows
points: CoinDesk reports active RWA market cap has surpassed $30B, with tokenized equities leading inflows.
CryptoRank reports RWA spot trading volume up 220% from Q2 2025 to Q2 2026 and RWA deposits rising from $2.3B to $7.4B.
newsStories.takeaway: RWA growth is increasingly showing up in both asset value and actual trading activity.

newsStories.headline: Bitfinex Securities raises $50M for tokenized nickel push
points: CoinDesk reports Bitfinex Securities raised $50M as it moves to offer tokenized nickel exposure.
The story broadens tokenization beyond stocks, Treasuries and real estate into industrial commodities.
newsStories.takeaway: The tokenization thesis is spreading across asset classes.

newsStories.headline: Stablecoin rules and bank competition keep developing
points: The digest says Treasury has proposed GENIUS Act rules governing payment-stablecoin issuance and sales.
It also repeats the emerging bank response: institutions that fought stablecoins are considering their own blockchain-based money products.
newsStories.takeaway: Stablecoins are becoming a regulated payments and banking competition story.
newsStories.source: National Law Review / WSJ / Aug 28 digest

aiStories.headline: AI agents are getting wallets
points: TNW highlights infrastructure emerging around AI agents, digital wallets and micropayments.
The important question is what changes when software agents can hold value and transact autonomously.
aiStories.takeaway: The agent economy becomes materially different once agents can control money.

aiStories.headline: Anthropic launches tool for AI-controlled scientific experiments
points: The Financial Times digest item says Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard enables AI agents to autonomously operate programmable devices used in experiments.
This moves agent capability beyond software workflows and into physical systems.
aiStories.takeaway: AI agents are crossing from digital automation into real-world machine operation.

aiStories.headline: Bill Gates pushes for global action on AI risks
points: Reuters reports Gates wants to discuss international AI-risk mitigation efforts with China's Xi Jinping.
The debate continues shifting from model capability toward governance and societal impact.
aiStories.takeaway: AI governance is becoming an international coordination problem.

sportsStories.headline: NFL roster cut weekend is here
points: CBS Sports flags 20 veterans who could be among roster-cut casualties as teams trim to 53 players.
This is one of the final major personnel checkpoints before the regular season.
sportsStories.takeaway: Watch roster cuts for depth-chart changes that can affect early-season markets.

sportsStories.headline: NFL preseason Week 3 continues
points: NFL.com published takeaways from Thursday's Week 3 preseason games.
Keep preseason and regular-season schedules clearly separated in the Betting Desk.
sportsStories.takeaway: Preseason information matters, but don't confuse these games with regular-season matchups.

sportsStories.headline: Tom Aspinall rejects UFC exit rumors
points: The UFC heavyweight champion says reports that he is leaving the organization are false while he recovers from an eye injury.
sportsStories.takeaway: Aspinall remains with UFC; the story is about his recovery and future return.

sportsStories.headline: MLB CBA negotiations focus on roster stability
points: MLB.com says the league presented proposals to the MLBPA aimed at creating more roster stability.
Use today's live MLB schedule for any betting recommendations rather than the digest's prior-day game links.
sportsStories.takeaway: The CBA story belongs in Sports; live games belong in Betting Desk.

sportsStories.headline: FedExCup finale underway at East Lake
points: Min Woo Lee opened with a bogey-free 62 and eight birdies.
Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy are among the players chasing at East Lake.
sportsStories.takeaway: A clean live golf storyline for the Sports segment.
